findings.message: Camunda 7 does not subscribe messages by correlationKey; the key is dropped.
findings.suggestion: Correlate with a business key or correlation variables when sending the message.

findings.message: zeebe:executionListeners has no Camunda 7 equivalent and was dropped.
findings.suggestion: Reimplement the behavior in Camunda 7 or accept the difference.
